'''Duncan Hikmat''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the planet [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]] who served the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] as a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]] pilot during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. At some point during his life, Hikmat was featured in ''[[Action Tidings]]'' and ''[[Figg Daily Bulletin]]'' after apprehending a group of [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] art [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="SWI" /> He co-piloted one of two [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud cars]] near [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] arrived there. One Cloud Car fired warning shots at the freighter before escorting it to a landing platform.<ref name="TESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character's co-pilot, [[Jell Spiel]], was most prominently seen as an action figure in [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' toy line]]<ref name="Kenner">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (toy line)|pack=(Twin Pod) Cloud Car Pilot|link=VINtCloudcarpilot.asp}}</ref>, though both pilots can be briefly glimpsed inside the Cloud Cars in the film.<ref name="TESB" /> Close up photos of the Cloud Car prop used in the film shows two different pilots inside the pods, with then unnamed Hikmat distinguished by a mustache.<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref><ref name="SVC24">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 24|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 24]]</ref><ref name="SWTC">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/swtc/exhibit/cloudcar.html|text=Photos from ''Star Wars: The Magic of Myth'' exhibit|work=TheForce.net|archivedate=20061005171214}}</ref> In [[2010]], [[Hasbro]] released an action figure based on this particular character, though the packaging mimics the original Kenner figure's, using the photo of the other pilot.<ref name="TVC">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|pack=#011: (Twin Pod) Cloud Car Pilot|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/Twin_Pod_Cloud_Car_Pilot_Vintage_Collection_TVC_VC11.asp}}</ref> Hikmat's name and personal history were finally revealed in the [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] feature of [[Star Wars Insider 148|''Star Wars Insider'' 148]].<ref name="SWI" />

The figures' full uniforms were based on concept art by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]], which was later used to represent [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] officer [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]] in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''.<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>
